{{Top|leg}}
'''Deep space satellite tenders''' were a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. One of the most common conversions of a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]], the craft was intended for the specialized use of looking after [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
